profile_text.body:
C3.ai, Inc. is recorded as a for-profit public company with the ticker AI, headquartered in Redwood City, California, and CIK 0001577526. The record lists no tracked products, no MCP servers, and no lawsuits. It does carry a law exposure entry for California with a count of 270.

The website text supplied with the company describes Air Liquide, not C3.ai. That text says Air Liquide is a world leader in gases, technologies and services for industry and healthcare, present in 59 countries with approximately 65,000 employees, serving 4.3 million customers and patients, with revenues close to 27 billion euros in 2025. It states the company dates to 1902, describes Innovation Campuses and digital work, cites two contracts supporting the operational phase of Ariane 6 after 50 years of collaboration, reports H1 2026 results, and warns about fraudulent offers of Air Liquide shares.

Because the harvested site content and the company identity do not match, the material supports little beyond the registry facts above: a public company, ticker AI, Redwood City headquarters, and a California law exposure count of 270.
